_comment: Project-scoped settings shipped with the evolve-loop plugin. Four PreToolUse hooks enforce structural trust boundaries: (1) ship on Bash — a ship-class git/gh command must itself be the native evolve ship CLI, judged per simple command. (2) phase on Agent|Task — denies in-process subagent dispatch while a cycle is active, forcing phase agents through the native bridge (ADR-0075; phase ORDER is enforced by the go/internal/core state machine, not this hook). (3) role on Edit|Write — files can only be modified by the active phase within its allowlisted paths, judged on the clean path. (4) docdelete on Bash — blocks rm/mv on docs/** or knowledge-base/** without canonical archival mv. Each hook prefers the freshly-built go/bin/evolve and falls back to the tracked go/evolve when go/bin is missing, so the kernel fails closed even if build outputs are wiped. The guards read no environment; the emergency bypass is the guard command's --bypass flag, and routine bypassing is a CLAUDE.md violation. PostToolUse on Edit|Write syntax-checks the modified file by extension; it never blocks, only emits WARN to the agent's stderr.
